posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked: I've got some thoughts about what it might be for some of these - I've already called that I think Visionary Unleashed will be a direct damage power, possibly limited AOE. Conversely, I think that Fugue State Parse will be a deck manipulation power of some kind. I also think that Heavy Metal AA will be able to trigger multiple performs/accompanies, but at the cost of some self-damage. Extreme Tempest might be a mini-Localized Hurricane kind of effect - 2 damage to 2 targets, or 1 to 2 targets & draw.
